sam (Partnerships): Partner ops asked for a complete security bundle to approve our AWS Marketplace listing. Deadline = 2026-04-12. They asked for SOC2, pen-test summary, vuln artifacts, signed DPA, and a completed security questionnaire.

mike (Security): Noted. We have a SOC2 Type II PDF from last quarter. Pen-test results are sensitive, so we can provide a redacted executive summary + remediation timeline.

tara (Eng): I can export the infra diagram and a short appendix with VPC/subnet details. Will include NAT, peering, and endpoints used by the marketplace integration.

emma (Product): Quick checklist: 1) SOC2 PDF, 2) Pen-test exec summary (redacted), 3) Nessus/Qualys scan CSVs for last 30 days, 4) DAST/SCA summary, 5) Arch + dataflow diagrams, 6) DPA signed, 7) Security questionnaire filled, 8) One-page attestation letter. Assign owners below.

mike (Security): I9ll handle SOC2, redaction of pen-test logs, vuln CSV export, and questionnaire answers. Expect drafts by 2026-04-08.

sam (Partnerships): I9ll coordinate portal upload and rename files per their naming rules. @legal please prepare DPA signature routing.

legal (Legal): On it. Send me the partner template and our standard DPA. We should confirm whether they require a countersigned DOC or an e-sign.

tara (Eng): File names I9ll produce: redwood-arch-marketplace-2026-04.svg and redwood-network-appendix-2026-04.pdf. Will also include a short runbook snippet for onboarding.

mike (Security): Pen-test note: open issue CVE-2025-XYZ in gateway; remediation PR merged tomorrow and patch deploy scheduled 2026-04-02. I will reflect the remediation ETA in the summary.

sam (Partnerships): Partner replied: "Portal accepts uploads or SFTP. Preferred: portal. Please include a short summary of encryption (KMS/HSM) and data residency (US/EU)."

emma (Product): I9ll draft the attestation letter: short bullet list confirming SOC2 scope, encryption at rest/in transit, key management, and incident response contact.

deploy-bot: Weekly infra-scan report: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/weekly-2026-03-30 1 infra findings (low) in last scan.

mike (Security): Upload checklist I9ll use:
- SOC2_TypeII_Redwood.pdf
- PenTest_ExecSummary_redacted.pdf
- Vulnerability_Scans_20260322.csv
- DAST_Summary.pdf
- SCA_Report.zip
- Architecture_Diagram.svg
- Network_Appendix.pdf
- DPA_Redwood_signed.pdf
- Security_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx
- Attestation_Letter.pdf

sam (Partnerships): Timeline recap: drafts to review by 2026-04-08, internal signoffs by 2026-04-09, upload by 2026-04-11 to give partner ops a day. Will ping reviewers when docs land in the shared drive.

emma (Product): Sounds good. If legal needs anything for the attestation wording, I9ll work with you. If anyone finds additional low/med findings that could affect listing, post here immediately. :thumbsup:
